title: [Mouse Highlighter] Yellow highlight circle stays on screen and does not disappear

judgment.rationale: Compare tray versus keyboard activation and observe button-up/fade state. A stale input/visual lifecycle is a hypothesis; another ZIP request would not resolve it.
evidence: On 0.102.2933, enabling through the tray leaves a yellow circle at the click position that never fades.
Settings screenshots and a bug-report ZIP already exist; the automated archive rejection does not erase the supplied reproduction.

Upstream main 9e6593c34949: src/modules/MouseUtils/MouseHighlighter/MouseHighlighter.cpp: Mouse events are queued; button down/up and fade animation are separate transitions, with explicit zero-duration normalization.

fix_assessment.rationale: Conditional lightweight proposal, not an implementation-grade design. The screenshot/repro localizes a persistent visual, but does not prove which transition is missing.

proposed_fixes.title: Clear stale activation-click visuals
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Tray activation may leave a pressed-button visual without its matching release/fade transition; this has not been reproduced.
plan: Compare activation paths and identify the first unmatched input/visual state.
If confirmed, initialize or reconcile button visual state at activation without dropping genuine held drags.
Add tray-enable, shortcut-enable and disable/re-enable regressions.
verification: Released clicks always fade; held clicks remain visible only while intended.
Zero and nonzero fade settings both work.

confidence.rationale: The screenshot/repro localizes a persistent visual, but does not prove which transition is missing.
